ghost_color.description: Ghost tint color as #RRGGBB, blended over the native planning color using Ghost tint opacity. Save and reload your colony after changing appearance settings.

ghost_tint_opacity.description: Tint strength in percent: 0 keeps the native planning color, 20 gives a softer tint, 100 uses the full selected color. This does not make models see-through. Save and reload to apply.
